title: New Slide (StorylineAndReview)

scenarios.title: New Slide applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: New Slide (BtnNewSlide) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: New Slide bounded overload inserts exactly one blank slide after the current one in real PowerPoint
scenarios.expected: In an isolated real PowerPoint host, the deployed New Slide bounded InsertBlankAfterCurrent overload adds exactly one slide after the current one (measured count 1 to 2), returns true, writes no new entry in the oPenEfficiency error log of the run day, and leaves the host stable.
